scope: Adapter closure for already reviewed transient guards, optional bias probe, exact installed notice and supplied-netlist metadata. Focused synthetic/software validation only; final acceptance belongs to Astra.
verified_existing_adapter_behavior: Reject simulator abort text even with exit status zero and a complete final timestamp.
Reject incomplete/overshoot time, nonfinite data, wrong column count, one-row data, backwards time, late or negative start before metrics or preview emission.
Accept endpoint rounding within rtol=1e-8 and atol=1e-12; tested +/-4 ps at requested 4 ms.
Optional measure_bias_current=False removes only internal Vbias probe, expects eight columns, and records bias reference power as null/unavailable while preserving whole-clock and receiver power.
Canonical schematic routing limitation is conditional; caller-supplied netlist coverage follows its provenance without filename inference.
Receiver cells retain the complete installed preamble before the first subcircuit.

executed_checks.command: Read-only Python verification of actual clock.py preamble assignments against installed SKY130 HD source

milestone3_manifest_read_only_audit.required_action: None for this closure: current adapter hash already matches; preserve historical workflow hashes and no-rerun note.

limitations: All clock adapter outputs in focused tests are synthetic; they do not establish physical clock frequency, PVT behavior, extraction coverage or PV power feasibility.
No circuit, layout or notebook was launched; the separate physical/electrical evidence task owns those results.
No clock.py, canonical circuit, shared manifest or shared documentation edits were made during this closure; earlier reviewed source changes were verified in place.
No publish, push, commit or fabrication action was performed.
